positions.title: Software engineer II
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Designed an RFC and PoC on introducing Buildkit that leveraged caching and reduced Docker build times from a build that averaged ~5m to ~1m45s. Led development of the OKR after the RFC was approved based on the result of the PoC.

- Drove adoption of flagger, a progressive delivery kubernetes service. Adoption led to faster development for teams and increased resiliency for production applications.

- Managed and maintained infrastructure for self-hosted Github enterprise and CI/CD tool (Buildkite) that was responsible for all decoupled deployments (~15,000 deploys/mo). Infrastructure was built in Terraform across multiple DCs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated on refactoring a Jenkins job that hydrates feature toggles’(FT) Redis cache in production that reduced update time from 3 mins to 5 secs by concurrently updating all datacenters.

- Re-architected backend caching for FTs in development leveraging Consul’s key value store and reduced load time for FT fetching from 5 mins to 3 secs by generating JSON files on virtual machines with current state of FTs.

- Designed and implemented a bot for Slack leveraging Slack’s web api for real time messaging alerting users in their channels about the changes made to an FT.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Front-End Development and +15 skills

positions.title: Bootcamp Prep Instructor
positions.description:
Introduced students to the fundamentals of JavaScript, ES5 and ES6 syntax.
Gave 1 on 1 tutoring sessions to students, strengthening their pair-programming skills and strengthening their problem solving abilities.

projects.title: PinIt
projects.description: A full stack SPA clone of Pinterest built on a React frontend that utilizes AWS S3 cloud storage to store photos accessible through reference on the backend PostgreSQL database. Utilizes Redux to conditionally render modals & drop-downs as well as keeping overall state predictable. Frontend communicates with backend via a RESTful API implemented in Rails. Hand-rolled robust frontend and backend user authentication and authorization checks which prevents the user from making AJAX requests or visiting certain pages before logging in. The BCrypt gem is used to salt and hash users passwords storing that value as a password digest in the database.

projects.title: Return of Bass
projects.description: Return of Bass is a run and jump platform game with disappearing and reappearing platforms. The game employs object oriented principles and accurately detects collision between objects. The layout was designed through frequent test phases where several people played at each step, it also has a custom built physics engine that mimics gravity and friction.
